About the Role Anthropic is growing quickly across EMEA, and we need recruiters who can help us hire exceptional people into the teams that keep the company running and bring our work to customers. We’re looking for a Recruiter to join our Talent team based in London to own full-cycle recruiting of our G&A functions (Policy, Finance, Legal, People, and related areas). This is a full-cycle individual-contributor role for a strong recruiter who can run an excellent process end to end—sourcing, screening, managing stakeholders, and closing. You’ll partner with hiring managers across EMEA to understand what great looks like, build healthy pipelines, and deliver a candidate experience that reflects Anthropic’s values. You’ll work in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift, and you’ll have real ownership over the roles you run. We’re open to candidates whose strength is in G&A recruiting in your application, tell us where your experience is deepest across the functions. Key Responsibilities Own full-cycle recruiting for a portfolio of G&A roles across EMEA—from intake through offer and close Partner with hiring managers to scope roles, calibrate the bar, and build effective sourcing strategies Source and engage high-quality active and passive candidates, building diverse and competitive pipelines Run structured, rigorous, and candidate-centric interview processes that uphold Anthropic’s hiring bar Manage candidates through the process with clear communication and a great experience at every stage Collaborate with the broader Talent team, People Partners, and Compensation to structure offers and guide candidates to close Use data to track pipeline health and share insight that helps hiring managers make good decisions Minimum Qualifications 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in G&A (Policy, Finance, Legal, People) with a focus on Policy hiring Demonstrated ability to recruit in the UK and European market, with familiarity with local talent dynamics and employment norms Track record of strong stakeholder partnership — building trust quickly with hiring managers in fast-moving environments Comfortable operating with ambiguity: willing to flex between functions and contribute to building something new rather than running an established playbook Proven ability to maintain quality under volume pressure — owns pipeline health, not just pipeline size Self-starter who can work with significant autonomy while staying tightly aligned with global strategy Genuine connection to Anthropic's mission and an understanding of why it matters in a recruiting context Preferred Qualifications Experience recruiting at a high-growth technology, AI, or machine learning company Experience recruiting across both G&A and GTM functions Experience hiring across multiple EMEA markets, including the UK and Ireland Familiarity with Greenhouse or similar ATS platforms Additional European language skills relevant to hiring across the region The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £105,000 — £145,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Treasury Manager
items.description: About Legend Legend is a world-leading sports and gaming media network, reaching hundreds of millions of visitors a year. We're now part of Genius Sports. Together, we’re combining Legend’s audience, brands and product expertise with Genius Sports’ real-time data, technology and capabilities to create the next generation of fan-facing media and advertising Here at Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company. Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive. The Role Great treasury is about more than managing cash. It's about giving a business the confidence to grow, make decisions and move forward. As Legend and Genius Sports bring their expertise together, our Treasury function is evolving to support a larger, more complex international business. We're looking for a Treasury Manager to join our team in St Helier, Jersey and play a key role in shaping how we manage cash, liquidity and financial risk across the Group. Reporting to our Group Head of Treasury, you'll take ownership of the day-to-day treasury operations that keep our business moving. From providing clear visibility of our cash position to managing covenant reporting and global banking activities, you'll make sure we have the right information, controls and processes in place to operate with confidence. This isn't just about keeping things running. You'll have the opportunity to challenge existing processes, introduce smarter ways of working and help build a more efficient, scalable Treasury function through better systems, data and automation. If you're a hands-on treasury professional who enjoys solving problems, taking ownership and making a real impact, this is an opportunity to bring your expertise to a business that's continuing to evolve. We value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed. Your Impact: Keep our cash working smarter. Own short-term liquidity forecasting, strengthen cash visibility across the Group and identify funding needs, risks and opportunities before they become challenges. Bring confidence to our financial commitments. Take ownership of covenant calculations, compliance monitoring and lender reporting, delivering accurate, forward-looking insights that support better financial decisions. Make global treasury operations run seamlessly. Manage banking relationships and administration, account mandates, cash movements and controls, ensuring our operations remain accurate, efficient and well-governed. Stay one step ahead of financial risk. Monitor FX exposures and hedging activities, support financial risk analysis and highlight emerging risks to help protect the Group's financial position. Build a smarter Treasury function. Challenge existing processes, improve forecasting and data quality, strengthen controls and help introduce technology and automation that make our operations more scalable. What You'll Bring: Hands-on treasury experience. A background in corporate treasury, cash management or corporate finance within a commercial environment, with the confidence to take ownership and deliver independently. Strong cashflow and liquidity expertise. Experience building and managing forecasts, investigating variances and translating financial data into meaningful insights. Knowledge of debt and covenant reporting. Practical experience preparing or managing covenant calculations, monitoring compliance and supporting accurate lender reporting. A solid understanding of treasury operations. Experience managing banking administration, mandates and cash management processes, alongside an understanding of FX exposure and financial risk. An analytical mindset with an eye for improvement. Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills, combined with an interest in using systems, technology and automation to work smarter. Sound judgement and a collaborative approach. Strong attention to detail, the ability to spot and escalate risks, and the confidence to work independently while building relationships across Finance. The Interview Process: Initial conversation with our Talent Partner – A 30-minute Zoom call to learn more about you, your experience and what you're looking for in your next move. Meet our Finance & Treasury team – A 60-minute Zoom interview to explore your treasury expertise, approach to problem-solving and how you could contribute to the team. Practical task & presentation – You'll have a few days to complete a relevant treasury exercise before presenting your approach and recommendations to the team. Final conversation with our Finance & People team – A 60-minute interview at our St Helier office to get to know each other better, explore how we work and answer any remaining questions. Additional Information When you apply for a role with Legend through the Genius Sports careers site, the information you provide as part of your application will initially be collected through Genius Sports' recruitment software provider, Greenhouse, on our behalf and for our purposes only. Your application and related personal data may then be transferred to our recruitment platform, Lever, where it will be processed in accordance with our privacy notice, which you can find here https://l1.com/privacy-policy Legend is an Equal Opportunity Employer, but that’s just the start. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please speak to your Talent Partner or contact the team on talent@l1.com , and we'll do all we can to support you.

items.title: VP Product, Cloud & Inference
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE TEAM Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud. Frontier models, developer tools, and now the compute to run them: the cloud is where Mistral's strategy comes together. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on our infrastructure, and the Cloud & Inference product team owns the products that make that possible: managed Kubernetes and GPU clusters, the pay-as-you-go inference APIs for our first-party models, and the fast-growing set of services around them. The portfolio runs on our own metal, in our own datacenters, backed by our own model research: the full stack under one roof. We are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute by 2030. Every layer of that build needs a product behind it: orchestration, storage, networking, serverless containers, training, and inference. The product team is small and the mandate is company-sized. As VP Product you will build the PM org this portfolio needs, set its strategy, and carry it to market with the GTM, marketing, and partnerships teams. The products you define are how Mistral's sovereign AI strategy meets its customers. THE ROLE We are hiring a VP of Product to own our cloud and inference portfolio end to end: the foundational systems that power Mistral's data centres, and the inference platform that brings the world's most advanced generative AI models to production. You will define the vision and strategy, and you will own the business results: adoption, revenue contribution, and gross margin. This is a broad mandate. You will build the product organisation and, as the business scales, bring in the stream leadership to delegate its parts. You will set the operating rhythm that lets a fast-moving org deliver with focus, and your remit grows with the portfolio: what you run hands-on in year one, you lead through others as the org grows. The portfolio runs in production today. The job ahead of you is the scale-up: a gigawatt of compute to fill, a product surface that keeps expanding, and a major new line of business to build on the foundation already in place. This is a highly visible role, with the opportunity to shape how Mistral's technology is adopted globally. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Strategy & vision. Define and evangelise the product vision, strategy, and annual goals for our Cloud and Inference products, aligned with customer needs, company objectives and market trends. - Go-to-market. Own adoption, revenue contribution, and gross margin. Partner with marketing and GTM teams on positioning, pricing and packaging, launch plans, and adoption strategy. - Team leadership. Build the product organization for these products: hire product managers and stream leads, set the operating cadence (quarterly product reviews, roadmap reviews), and develop PMs through clear growth paths. - Customer & market fit. Work directly with AI-native startups and enterprises running advanced AI workloads to drive product-market fit across the portfolio. - Delivery & execution. Partner with engineering leadership to build a world-class compute infrastructure and inference platform delivering high-performance, cost-efficient AI at scale, with reliability, SLAs, and cost-per-token economics as first-class product concerns. - Market & technology insights. Track the competitive landscape and emerging technologies across AI infrastructure and managed inference to inform product strategy and identify new opportunities. - Research & open source. Partner with research and engineering teams to turn emerging model architectures and advances in open-source inference into product opportunities that improve performance and efficiency. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Extensive experience in tech and infrastructure, including significant time leading product organisations with a proven track record of bringing cloud infrastructure, large-scale distributed systems, or inference products to market. - You've scaled a cloud or inference product line to $1B+ in revenue: built the line, priced it, taken it to market, and owned the number. - Engineering background prior to moving into product management. - Proven people leadership: you've hired and developed senior PMs, grown the leaders under you, organised teams around clear stream ownership, and built durable operating cadences. - Fluency in the economics of the business: comfortable owning gross margin, unit economics, and the tradeoffs behind pricing and capacity. - Ability to align and inspire cross-functional teams without direct authority, and to communicate credibly with executives, engineers, and customers. - Low ego, high bias for action, comfort in ambiguity, and hands-on by instinct. We are scrappy: you write the strategy memo, then dig into the pricing model, the product spec, or the customer escalation yourself. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Platform Acceleration
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As of May 2026, Claude authored more than 80% of the code we merge . In September 2026, we merged more than 30,000 changes per day . Writing a change is fast now, and the hard part is knowing what is correct and safe to ship. Platform Acceleration builds the internal tools that close that gap for Anthropic's product engineers, who own the Claude API, our SDKs, and the rest of the Claude Platform. We work like a small product team whose customers are other Anthropic engineers. We're looking for Staff+ engineers with a strong background in backend or infrastructure who care about developer experience and have built tools other engineers rely on. We prefer candidates who can work from our San Francisco office, and we'll also consider candidates based in Seattle. What you'll do Design, build, and operate the tools that help product teams ship faster Own the technical strategy and roadmap for your area, and make sure its hardest problems get solved, by you or through others Define what it means to trust a change, especially changes written by Claude, and build the tooling that holds the bar throughout the software development lifecycle Build agents that take on repetitive engineering work, such as diagnosing failures, fixing broken tests, and running migrations Embed with partner teams to find their biggest sources of friction, validate a solution with them, and turn the fix into a product other teams can adopt Move between building new tools and improving the shared systems that teams already depend on, as priorities shift You might be a good fit if you: Experience building and operating backend services or infrastructure in production, in Go, Python, Rust, or TypeScript Deep experience with developer tooling, CI/CD, test infrastructure, or deployment systems Experience leading large, complex technical projects across teams, from an ambiguous problem to a solution developers adopt Clear written and verbal communication, with experience supporting internal partner teams Interest in Anthropic's mission of building safe, beneficial AI Preferred qualifications: Experience at a startup or on a similarly small team, taking a product from zero to one and talking directly to your users Substantial experience with agents that do engineering or other technical work Experience building widely adopted CLI tools, developer-facing services, GitHub automation, or open source developer tools Experience measuring developer productivity and using the data to decide what to build A point of view on how software engineering changes as agents write more of the code Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Location Preference: Preference will be given to candidates based in NY, SEA, SF or the Bay Area given the current location of team. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE You’ll use your creativity, problem-solving, and technical expertise to design tailored solutions that make a real impact. Embedded with our most strategic customers, you’ll get a front-row seat to some of our highest-stakes projects. From brainstorming technical architectures and product features to building full-scale integrations, you’ll take full ownership of complex, high-impact challenges—helping clients achieve their goals and push the limits of what’s possible. What you will do: - Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions. - Collaborate daily with our customer’s engineers and executives teams to ensure the best use of ElevenLabs’ technologies. - Drive real innovation by using your coding and technical skills to solve complex problems, making a real difference for our customers. REQUIREMENTS - Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity - Proficiency in Python and strong software development knowledge, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and APIs integration. - Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. Especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical knowledge and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. #LI-remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Researcher, Safety - Frontier Assurance
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Frontier Assurance team strengthens OpenAI’s safety decisions through independent expertise, rigorous assessment, and public transparency. We coordinate external evaluations of frontier models and safeguards, develop approaches such as embedded auditing, and manage the misalignment disclosure process and safeguard testing. Our work helps independent experts scrutinize OpenAI’s safety approach and ensures their findings inform consequential decisions about advanced AI systems. ABOUT THE ROLE As a researcher on Frontier Assurance, you will build the technical foundations for rigorous assessments of frontier AI risks. You will help design technical assessments with external evaluators and internal teams: identify consequential safety claims to test, define the evidence and methods needed to assess them, and address gaps in coverage. You will work closely with external evaluators and embedded auditors, helping them understand the systems they are assessing and access the models, data, and technical information their work requires. Where direct access is not possible, you will conduct experiments and analyses on their behalf, with methods and results they can meaningfully scrutinize. This role combines research engineering, experimental design, and close technical collaboration. You will move between investigating specific safety questions, navigating complex internal systems, and building reusable tools that make assessments more thorough and efficient. Your work will help turn independent scrutiny into concrete evidence about model capabilities, safeguards, and remaining risks. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Help design assessments with external evaluators and internal teams: identify consequential safety claims to test, define the evidence and methods needed to assess them, and address gaps in coverage. - Support the technical execution of third-party assessments and embedded audits focused on frontier risks, working with evaluators to translate research questions into experiments, analyses, and evidence requirements. - Pair closely with external researchers to provide the data, technical documentation, and context needed to assess models and safeguards. Help them understand relevant system behavior, configurations, and limitations. - Design and implement secure access to assessment environments, working with research, engineering, and security teams to make relevant models, tools, and information available. - Conduct experiments and run analyses on evaluators’ behalf when direct access is constrained. Develop methods collaboratively, document implementation choices, and make results reproducible and open to challenge. - Build tooling that automates auditing, assessment workflows, and internal assurance work, including evidence collection, evaluation execution, and tracking changes across model or safeguard versions. - Reproduce external findings, investigate discrepancies with internal results, and work with relevant teams to test proposed mitigations and identify unresolved questions. - Document methods, findings, and limitations clearly so that evaluators and internal decision-makers can understand what the evidence establishes and where uncertainty remains. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have strong software engineering skills and experience building research tools, evaluation infrastructure, or systems for analyzing complex data. - Have practical experience working with modern machine learning systems, including designing experiments, running evaluations, and interpreting results. - Can navigate unfamiliar codebases and infrastructure, debug across system boundaries, and turn ambiguous research requests into reliable technical implementations. - Bring sound judgment to experimental design and measurement, including identifying confounders, limitations, and gaps in evidence. - Enjoy working closely with researchers, explaining technical systems, and helping others investigate difficult questions. - Value independent scrutiny and can support rigorous assessments that challenge internal assumptions. - Have an understanding of, or strong interest in, frontier AI risks, alignment, and the evaluation of safeguards. Experience with AI safety evaluations, adversarial testing, security research, or technical auditing would be especially relevant. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic believes AI capabilities are improving rapidly, and that AI safety policy needs to keep pace. Our Policy Development team translates technical insights into workable new policy ideas for governing frontier AI. As a member of the Policy Development team, you will drive our work on technical and cross-lab safety practices, deepen our work on frontier AI legislation, and develop new technical governance ideas that you pressure-test with researchers and carry into policy proposals. You will work closely with policy colleagues and with research, alignment, safety, and legal teams, and you’ll move easily between technical detail and how policy actually gets made. Key responsibilities Help develop technical safety best practices and standards for frontier development, working closely with policy, research, and safeguards teams Support cross-lab discussions and initiatives and serve as the Anthropic representative in key standards initiatives and groups Review and give substantive input on federal, state, and global frontier AI safety bills, including on risk reporting, independent evaluation, and incident reporting, helping shape AI safety legislation development Work with our external affairs policy teams to strengthen our frontier AI legislative framework Contribute research and analysis across the policy team’s pacing workstreams, including developing novel policy proposals that address challenges related to the acceleration of AI R&D Engage with the external AI safety and governance community to track new thinking and feed it into our own Write clear memos and briefings that help leadership align on decisions Minimum qualifications Are fluent in frontier AI safety and technical AI governance: the main players, proposals, and debates Can read legislative text and comment usefully on it Have expertise in any of the following domains: loss-of-control, alignment, compute governance, independent evaluation, model weight security, risk reporting Write clearly for researchers, leadership, and policymakers Can pick up new technical topics quickly and translate them to the broader policy landscape Are comfortable with ambiguity and can own a project end to end Preferred qualifications Are excited about standards work, and also want to contribute across the wider technical governance agenda Have direct experience in an AI governance or safety research organization or frontier lab Have experience working closely with standards bodies or industry consortia Have experience developing and shaping technical legislation Have published novel policy thinking on AI governance The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.
